'''Ley-Watcher Incantigos''' is the second boss of [[Tower of Karazhan]]. Once a friend of the highborne [[Al'Dorel]], he sought to make a name for himself within the [[Blue dragonflight]] by advancing the cause of the great dampening. He sought to meet [[Malygos]] himself, but [[Haleh]] denied him this right, as she believed it was not yet time for them to meet.<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|62|And Lost to the Stars}}</ref> Thus, despite Al'Dorel counseling against it, Incantigos departed for the [[Eastern Kingdoms]], seeking out the chaotic power and unstable leylines that ran through [[Karazhan]] in order to harness and untangle them.<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|62|Asleep Under Snow}}</ref>
